_note: Wild nests (NPC colonies), docs/17-wild-nests.md; termite mounds, spider dens and aphid herds, docs/24-npcs.md. Level = highest level whose minPatchPoints <= the points of the strongest active player in the patch; never goes down. Times are hours at world speed 1 (divide by world speed).

pavement.name: Pavement Ants
pavement.style: Swarm: many Workers and Minor Soldiers. Major Soldiers cut through them.

fire.name: Fire Ants
fire.style: Aggressive: few but strong soldiers, Acid Sentries later. Send cheap Minor Soldiers, not Majors, into the acid.

carpenter.name: Carpenter Ants
carpenter.style: Fortress: walls and pit traps, few soldiers. Bring numbers; the defenses rebuild.

honeypot.name: Honeypot Ants
honeypot._stockPct: Percent of the level's normal food store, per resource: honeypot ants hoard Nectar in living storage jars.
honeypot.style: Hoarders: a big Nectar store, guarded by Workers and Minor Soldiers. Light to beat; bring Workers to carry it home.

trapjaw.name: Trap-jaw Ants
trapjaw.style: Ambushers: no Workers, just a few heavily armed Major Soldiers behind pit traps. Numbers win: swarm them with Minor Soldiers.

termite.name: Termites
termite._note: A termite mound (docs/24-npcs.md): a rich, heavily defended mid-game target on its own wild site. Its tier follows the area's strongest active player (minPoints), never drops. Regrows slowly and never raids.
termite.style: A fortress of armoured soldiers and walls, packed with chewed wood. Bring a big army of Major Soldiers and plenty of carriers.

spider.name: Trapdoor Spider
spider._note: A boss (docs/24-npcs.md): one huge spider and her young under a silk lid. One player can beat it late in the game; the Alliances build may reuse it for joint raids. Regrows over a week and never raids.
spider.style: One giant spider and her spiderlings. Her fangs cut through any ant; only a large army brings her down. A small raid can't wear her down: she's whole again next time.

_area: Where wild things live (docs/24-npcs.md): every patch within `range` patches (same region) of a patch with players gets a wild nest and an aphid herd. Termite mounds sit in patches where patch % every == offset, spider dens likewise, each spawned once a player lives within its range. Sites are extra spots in the wilds that never take one of the 12 colony spots.

herds._note: Aphid herds (docs/24-npcs.md). A herd makes Nectar only while a player's ants tend it. nectarPerHour by level (levels follow the area leader like wild nests: npc.levels[].minPatchPoints). Honeydew piles up in the herd (up to storeHours of production) and the tenders carry it home every deliverEveryHours. Left untended for wanderAfterHours, the herd wanders to another patch nearby. Hours at world speed 1.
herds.name: Aphid Herd
herds.style: Aphids on a stem, dripping honeydew. Tend them and they make Nectar for you; anyone can drive your tenders off and take over.

scents._note: What an unscouted wild scent hints at (docs/24-npcs.md).

nest.name: Wild scent
nest.text: It smells sharp, of wild ants. You can't tell which kind, how many, or what they store.

herd.name: Sweet scent
herd.text: It smells sweet, like honeydew. Something here could make Nectar.

mound.name: Woody scent
mound.text: It smells of chewed wood and damp earth. Something big was built here.

den.name: Danger scent
den.text: Silk threads on the ground and no ants anywhere near. Every scout's antennae say: careful.

raids._note: Raids by wild nests on players in their patch. Gentle: a fraction (partyShare) of the nest's soldiers (castes with attack >= soldierMinAttack; Workers stay home), slow so players see them coming. The party is worth at most maxPartyValuePctOfTargetPoints % of the target's points, counted in resources (formulas.json points.resourcesPerPoint).

swarm._note: Army-ant swarms (docs/20-swarms.md): each player colony is visited about every 4 days, with warningHours of notice. The swarm is sized by simulating the battle against what the colony has at home when the swarm is spotted, so the colony wins about defenderWinRate of the time if it keeps its army home. Hours are at world speed 1.
swarm.name: Army ant swarm
